disposition.selection_rule: Prefer hybrid_original if both independently pass; secondary hybrid_augmented only if original fails and secondary passes; no automatic production promotion

estimator.pitch: Raw cached YIN frequency, regardless of old RMS/correlation voicing gates; finite inclusive 50..700 Hz required
estimator.nominal_target: 16+10k ms; acquired at target+20 ms; no interpolation
estimator.natural_primary_mask: t>=64ms and t+32ms<=N; exact16+10k-ms nominal target grid

natural_baseline_identity_audit.comparison: Exact JSON numeric equality, no tolerance; all metric fields and prediction-outside-reference counts; same recording order.

synthetic_independent_audit.limitations: Byte identities and analytic arithmetic only; no new inference, natural holdout, or deployment qualification.

natural_development.evidence: Adaptive reuse of previously inspected and scored development; exploratory, not an independent holdout
natural_development.aggregation: pool recording counts within speaker-condition; equal16cell macro
natural_development.metric_units: Rates are fractions; cents are cents; percentile values here are equal-cell means of within-cell percentiles.
natural_development.weakest_condition: first_difference: original and augmented voiced success 54.44% and 56.47%; voicing false-negative rates 37.70% and 35.13%.

synthetic.original_300_waveform: Stationary 300 Hz fundamental, 0.075*(sin(phi)+0.5*sin(2*phi)+0.25*sin(3*phi)); not a pure tone.

limitations: The original endpoint candidate-oracle gate failed and remains failed; the 20 ms delayed target is a separate research contract.
The original MLP, GRU and augmented MLP candidate-selection failures remain documented. The hybrid bypasses their pitch selector; it does not validate that selector.
The hybrid raises joint error on natural development versus its own MLP by about 0.2875 and 0.5522 percentage points, despite passing the declared classical-comparator gates.

Only four development speakers and 80 short public utterances were assessed, repeated under four transformations. Repeated development use is adaptive and cannot support an independent natural generalization claim.
Fresh synthetic scenarios are a deterministic mechanism challenge, not a population holdout. Original and previous synthetic cohorts are regression evidence.
No sealed-test, seed-confirmation, calibrated F0-correctness, live microphone demonstration, clinical validation, or voice-duration/coverage aggregate qualification.
Prior browser timings measured a different pitch path; hybrid runtime and live capture behavior remain unqualified.
Reference extraction and physical timing limitations remain in ALIGNMENT_AUDIT.md and STREAMING_RESULTS.md. No physical end-to-end latency claim.
